title: Pure Perfection
description: pureperfection.com Pure Perfection GmbH is a German live communication agency founded in 2008 in Wiesbaden, ranked number one in the 2026 BlachReport German Event Creativity Ranking ahead of insglück and Vok Dams. With 72 to 80 employees across offices in Wiesbaden, Berlin, Düsseldorf and Florida, it delivered 133 events in 2025, with 90 of them abroad including Shanghai, Miami and Singapore. Led by co-founders Jan Rogozinski and Kim Meisinger, the agency works through three units: Pure Live for events, Pure Space for brand spaces and architecture, and Pure Content for storytelling and PR. Major clients include Audi, ŠKODA, L'Oréal, Bentley and Nestlé, with pharma being its largest vertical at 90 events per year. Revenue peaked at 26.4 million euro in 2023 and the agency won 60 MUSE Creative Awards in 2026 alone.
